notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Next Message Request Available implementation to the exact C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the official signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors, including a filesystem report that preserves the supplied request boundary when a queued message produces an earlier grant, default-source and explicit-source regional interactions delivered at the inclusive NMRA boundary, a default-source timestamped attribute-update companion in the shared FQR/TARA/NMRA frontier, a mixed-member regional FQR/TARA/NMRA frontier, the bounded timestamped-save admission boundary, and a saved-pending NMRA restore under both callback models. It is not catalog evidence, protected-review evidence, package support, or a conformance claim.
